say:5:1010008006:1.text: I am Hogan, the former leader of the Heroic Order of the <style="highlight">Lightbearer Empire</style> and the current magistrate of <style="highlight">Holistone</style>.

say:10:1010008010:1.text: Then, our most pressing concern is to put out the fire.
say:10:1010008010:1.source_cn: 所以我们的当务之急是灭火。

say:11:1010008013:1.text: Please give me a hand, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's put this fire out together!

say:13:1010008011:1.text: Seems my instincts were right... This fire was no accident.
say:13:1010008011:1.source_cn: 看来我的直觉很对……这场火灾不是一起意外。

say:14:1010008012:1.text: Hahaha... As expected of the mage who was named Merlin! You never change.
say:14:1010008012:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈……不愧是继承了梅林之名的大魔法师，真像你的作风。

say:15:1010008004:1.text: Oh, I really hope this is the last time I hear this question from you.
say:15:1010008004:1.source_cn: 唉……真希望这是我最后一次从你嘴里听到这个问题。

say:16:1010008005:1.text: But no matter how many times you lose your memory, I'm happy to reintroduce myself again to you.
say:16:1010008005:1.source_cn: 但是，无论你失忆多少次，我都愿意重新向你自我介绍。
